Their passion is complemented by the work of veteran city penmakers who continue to handcraft ebonite fountain pens using time-honoured techniques, keeping alive a tradition that has endured well into the digital age

title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work
content: Unlike most communities in India, the Banchhadas in M.P. invest more in their daughters’ upbringing than in their sons’, by giving them better nutrition and clothes, only so that they can force them into sex work and live off their earnings. Branded a ‘criminal tribe’ by the British and now classified as a Scheduled Caste, the community remains on society’s margins as government and NGOs have struggled to break the cycle, reports Mehul Malpani

content: The Karnataka Mango Development and Marketing Corporation will develop a dedicated platform to facilitate the sale of Alphonso mangoes in the domestic market.

content: Residents travel at least 5-10 km to fetch a few pots of water from Kilpennathur and Tiruvannamalai towns due to irregular water supply

title: 'Brings back Asian Games memories': Neeraj on India's historic CWG javelin medals
content: Neeraj Chopra secured a silver medal in the javelin throw at the Commonwealth Games.  He shared the podium with fellow Indian Yashvir Singh, who won bronze.  Yashvir achieved a personal best throw on his final attempt to claim the medal.  Chopra expressed happiness at sharing the podium with another Indian athlete.  This silver medal adds to Chopra's extensive collection of career achievements.

title: 'Sorry to entire nation, I'm just 15': Noida girl on 'abusing' PM Modi
content: A Noida resident accused of abusing Prime Minister Modi posted an apology video claiming she is fifteen years old. She stated protesters influenced her remarks, calling it her first and last mistake. Police details and neighbor accounts suggest she is older and resides in Faridabad. The Zero FIR filed against her has been transferred to Delhi's Special Cell. Prime Minister Modi urged embracing young protesters rather than punishing them.

title: 'Same people who litter here, use dustbin abroad': Bombay HC on civic sense
content: A bench of Justices G S Kulkarni and Aarti Sathe made the observations while hearing a batch of petitions over pollution, foul odour, gas emissions and health hazards linked to the Kanjurmarg dumping ground in Mumbai. The judges said public participation was essential to keeping the city clean and urged civic authorities to enforce the rules without hesitation.

title: Pant trains with MS Dhoni ahead of Sri Lanka Test series; photo goes viral
content: Rishabh Pant trains with MS Dhoni in Ranchi for the upcoming Test series. Pant is preparing for the crucial Sri Lanka series after a recent IPL season. India needs strong performances in this series for the World Test Championship. Dhoni remains away from competitive cricket due to injury concerns. He is reportedly considered for a mentorship role with Chennai Super Kings.

title: SpaceX rocket to slam into Moon at 7 times speed of sound, leave fresh crater
content: Space tracking expert Bill Gray estimates the rocket will hit the Moon at around 5,400 mph (8,700 kph) near Einstein Crater on the Moon's sunlit western edge. The impact is expected to occur during the early hours of Wednesday, with the best viewing conditions likely across eastern parts of the United States and Canada, as well as much of South America.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Infantino drops FIFA World Cup private equity plan after global backlash
content: Gianni Infantino wanted to create a $20 billion company to manage FIFA's commercial business, including the men's and women's World Cups and Club World Cups. Under the proposal, private investors would own a 20% stake in the new company. The proposed "anchor investor" was a New York-based investment firm founded by Joshua Kushner, the younger brother of Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of U.S. President Donald Trump.

title: Spain says most migrants return to Morocco after border rush kills 57
content: Spanish authorities said 57 bodies had been recovered on the Spanish side of the border. Officials warned that the death toll could be higher as there may have been additional casualties on the Moroccan side. According to the government, some migrants drowned while others were crushed as they attempted to climb the breakwater supporting the border fence.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: In pics: PM Modi to inaugurate AI-equipped international airport in Andhra
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport on Saturday. He will also lay foundation stones for significant development projects worth over seventeen thousand nine hundred crore. The new airport is designed to handle six million passengers annually and boost regional connectivity. Foundation stone will be laid for Andhra Pradesh's first semiconductor manufacturing facility.

title: Singapore student vanishes after Cambodia flight ticket is found
content: A Singaporean student, Siti Aishah Siregar, disappeared after telling her family she was going to college. Her family discovered her passport missing and a flight ticket to Cambodia in her email. Singapore police confirmed the 20-year-old had already departed the country on an outbound flight. Her father issued an emotional appeal on Facebook for assistance to locate his daughter.

title: 13-year-old turns peanut shells into pesticide remover, eyes $25K prize
content: Thirteen-year-old Minnesota student Arika Kundu has designed a method that uses discarded peanut shells to help remove pesticide residues from fresh fruits and vegetables. Her project, called LIGNEX, has made her one of 10 finalists in the 2026 3M Young Scientist Challenge. She will now compete for the $25,000 grand prize with guidance from a 3M scientist.

title: MP man watches son die inside ambulance after oxygen runs out
content: A 21-year-old dialysis patient died inside an ambulance in Mandla district. The ambulance's oxygen supply reportedly ran out during the journey to the hospital. His family alleged he was not given oxygen despite breathing difficulties. The health department has ordered an inquiry into the unfortunate incident. A committee will investigate and submit its findings for appropriate action.

title: No Pant, no Samson, no Abhishek: Ashwin's India squad for 2027 ODI World Cup
content: Former spinner Ravichandran Ashwin shared his 2027 ODI World Cup squad selections. He categorized players into 'Yes', 'Maybe', and 'No' lists for the tournament. Ashwin included veteran pacer Bhuvneshwar Kumar in his preferred squad. He believes Bhuvneshwar can perform well in South African conditions. Rishabh Pant and Sanju Samson were notably absent from Ashwin's top picks.

title: Judoka Asmita Dey breaks down recalling late father after winning CWG gold
content: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a dramatic women's 48kg final match. This victory fulfilled a dream she feared was lost after her father's death. Her father had always supported her aspirations and encouraged her to dream big. Dey credited the support from SAI Bhopal for her continued progress.

title: 'Abusing no crime': Dipke slams FIR against Noida woman, recalls UP CM video
content: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke questioned an FIR against a woman for abusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He asked why similar action was not taken against BJP leaders and IT cell members. Dipke alleged that BJP IT cell members have abused women online for years. He also cited remarks by BJP leaders and the UP Chief Minister.

title: Wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara dies by suicide
content: Muskan Balhara, wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara, died by suicide Friday. Her family members are alleging harassment and staged a protest outside their residence. Police are investigating the incident and recording statements from family members. A forensic team has inspected the house and collected evidence for the ongoing inquiry. Muskan and Sheelu were married in December 2023 and have a young son.

title: Happy girlfriend day: Top 75 wishes, messages, greetings and quotes
content: Girlfriend Day offers a chance to express appreciation for loved ones.  Simple messages can convey deep feelings and strengthen relationships.  Personalizing sentiments makes them more meaningful and memorable for your girlfriend.  The article provides numerous examples for various relationship dynamics.  Ultimately, genuine connection is the most important gift you can give.

title: ‘Dhurandhar’ gangster’s brother shot in Karachi
content: Zubair Baloch, brother of jailed gangster Uzair Baloch, was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting. Two masked assailants on a motorcycle opened fire, striking him in the chest and abdomen. Zubair was rushed to Civil Hospital Karachi for emergency surgery after the attack. Police are investigating personal enmity and potential gang war resurgence as motives. The incident occurred in Karachi's Lyari neighborhood, a historic hub of organized crime.

title: Commercial LPG prices cut by over Rs 200: Check 19-kg rates in Delhi, Kolkata
content: Commercial Liquefied Petroleum Gas cylinder prices have been reduced effective August 1.  A 19 kg cylinder in Kolkata saw a Rs 209 price cut.  Delhi experienced a Rs 202 reduction for the same commercial cylinder.  This marks the second consecutive month of price decreases for commercial LPG.  Domestic LPG cylinder prices remain unchanged during this period.

title: CWG 2026: India’s finest day in Glasgow yet! Six medals, 10 boxing finalists
content: India produced its biggest day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning six medals to take its tally to 23. Historic judo golds for Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh, athletics medals from Tejaswin Shankar, Neeraj Chopra and Yash Vir Singh, plus a perfect 10-for-10 boxing run into finals highlighted a memorable Day 9 in Glasgow.

title: 'Buy $5-10 billion yen': Bessent's note hints at US plan to back Japan's currency
content: The United States Treasury is reportedly considering buying Japanese yen. This move follows reports of potential intervention in the currency market. Japanese authorities had already intervened to support their currency earlier. The dollar slipped against the yen as these reports emerged. This marks a significant intervention in support of Japan's currency.

title: PM Modi: I forgive those who abused me & my mother, our job to guide them
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will forgive young protesters accused of abuse. He stated these misguided children need guidance and correction, not punishment. The Prime Minister believes punishing them will not change circumstances effectively. Mistakes made at a young age present an opportunity for correction and societal acceptance. This decision indicates that cases against these youngsters will likely be withdrawn.

title: Zepto to delay IPO by 2-3 quarters, CEO tells staff
content: Zepto will delay its public listing by two to three quarters.  The quick commerce startup faced tepid investor response on its valuation.  Domestic investors offered valuations significantly lower than its last funding round.  The company now seeks Rs 1,000 crore in pre-IPO funding.  Zepto aims for a lower valuation of around $4-4.5 billion for this investment.

title: How Yashvir Singh's self-talk inspired a historic javelin bronze at CWG
content: Yashvir Singh secured a historic bronze medal with a personal best throw. Neeraj Chopra won the silver medal with his season's best performance. Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage claimed the gold medal in the event. Sharing the podium with Yashvir made the achievement more special for Chopra. Both athletes achieved significant milestones during the competition.

title: How family tragedy shaped Lamine Yamal's remarkable journey to football stardom
content: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.

title: Nolan Wells case takes shocking turn as California man arrested after death
content: It has been close to a month since Nolan Wells died tragically. While authorities investigate his case, a man has now been arrested for a different reason.

title: Brittany Mahomes breaks silence on women eyeing Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes
content: Patrick Mahomes and his wife Brittany Mahomes have been together for close to two decades now but it seems the attention has also sparked women pursuing the star player. The popular entrepreneur brittany Mahomes has now opened up about women pursuing her husband.

title: Chairman of company tried to get MD killed to avoid repaying Rs 32 crore, arrested
content: Waliv police arrested seven individuals, including the alleged mastermind, in an attempted murder case. The chairman of GSM Foils plotted to kill the managing director to evade repaying thirty-two crore rupees. He suffered significant financial losses after the US stock market crashed following the Iran-Israel conflict. The attack occurred at the company's premises, and the victim sustained a gunshot wound.

title: Monsoon likely to be ‘below normal’ in Aug-Sept: IMD
content: India's monsoon rainfall is expected to be below normal during August and September. This forecast is influenced by the continuing risk of El Niño, which often weakens the monsoon. July rainfall, however, turned out to be normal due to plentiful showers in central India. These showers helped reduce the overall monsoon rainfall deficit significantly by the end of July.

title: Trump threatens to hit Iran 'very hard' as US weighs fresh attack
content: President Trump threatened very hard hits on Iran, potentially targeting energy infrastructure. Reports suggest fresh strikes could begin as early as this weekend. The United States and Israel are discussing coordinated attacks on oil refineries and power plants. This operation would mark Israel's direct involvement in a new phase of strikes. White House aides reportedly raised strong objections to the proposed military campaign.

title: Amid opposition protest, Lok Sabha passes births & deaths bill
content: The Lok Sabha passed the Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill, 2026, without any debate. Opposition members disrupted Rajya Sabha proceedings, preventing any business from being transacted. The bill aims to make delayed registrations of births and deaths more stringent. Congress and SP MPs raised issues concerning police actions and alleged temple donation theft. The Rajya Sabha was ultimately adjourned for the entire day.

title: CWG Day 9 medal tally: Where is India now after delivering historic six-medal haul?
content: India enjoyed their best day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning six medals to take their tally to 23. Harsh Singh and Asmita Dey claimed historic judo golds, Neeraj Chopra secured javelin silver, Yash Vir Singh won bronze, Tejaswin Shankar earned India's first decathlon medal, and Yamini Mourya added judo silver as India closed on ninth-placed Wales.

title: Neeraj Chopra takes silver, Yashvir wins bronze as India secure two medals in javelin at CWG
content: Neeraj, the 28-year-old Tokyo Olympic champion, was not at his best in difficult weather but still managed a season-best throw of 85.83m in his second attempt to finish second.

title: Ethanol kept petrol prices lower: Govt
content: Ethanol blending saved consumers nearly thirty rupees per litre on petrol.  Global crude prices reached one hundred thirty-five dollars a barrel recently.  The government kept fuel prices unchanged for seventy-five days initially.  E20 petrol now costs one hundred two rupees per litre in Delhi.  Allegations of foodgrain diversion for ethanol were also rejected.

title: 'Project Kusha will cut India’s dependence on imported air shield systems'
content: India successfully tested its indigenous Project Kusha missile system recently. This development aims to create a homegrown long-range air defence capability. The system will counter aerial threats from China and Pakistan effectively. Project Kusha is designed to intercept various aerial targets up to 400 kilometers. Full military induction and deployment are expected between 2028 and 2030.

title: Chhattisgarh worker shot dead, another wounded in first J&K terror attack on migrants in 21 months
content: Terrorists shot dead a 24-year-old labourer from Chhattisgarh in Kulgam. Another worker from the same state was critically wounded in the attack. Security forces have launched operations to trace the attackers responsible for this incident. This incident marks the first fatal attack on migrant workers since October 18. Officials condemned the attack and directed security forces to intensify operations.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection: Thalapathy Vijay film drops 12.3%
content: Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan saw collections drop in its second week. The film earned an estimated 3.55 crore net on its ninth day. Overseas markets contributed 2 crore gross on the same day. Meanwhile, protests in Karnataka led to cancelled screenings at one theatre. The Tamil version continues to be the film's primary revenue generator.

title: Tahir Hussain gets life for IB staffer’s killing in 2020 riots
content: A Delhi court sentenced former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment.  They were convicted for the murder of Intelligence Bureau staffer Ankit Sharma.  The court found Sharma was lynched solely on account of his religion during the 2020 riots.  While the prosecution sought the death penalty, it was declined by the judge.  The judge considered educational backgrounds as a mitigating factor for the convicts.

title: Cybercriminals widen net as assessees rush to meet I-T return filing deadline
content: Cybercriminals are targeting taxpayers during income tax return filing season. They send fake notices via WhatsApp and use cloned tax portals. These scams aim to steal banking credentials and gain device access. Attackers use malware-laden attachments and phishing websites to deceive victims. This campaign exploits the expectation of official communications from the tax department.

title: 16.4% deleted in Haryana draft roll; 10.8% in Andhra Pradesh
content: Draft voter rolls in Haryana and Andhra Pradesh reveal significant exclusions.  Over sixteen percent of Haryana's electorate and over ten percent in Andhra were removed.  Reasons cited include deaths, permanent shifts, and multiple registrations.  However, genuine voters can still be added during the claims period.  This process allows for corrections and additions to the electoral rolls.

title: Gold loans jump 94% y-o-y, fuel bank credit growth in Q1
content: Gold loans fueled a significant acceleration in bank credit during Q1FY27. This segment expanded by 93.8% year on year, adding substantial value. Overall bank credit also saw robust growth, crossing a significant milestone. Credit to industry recorded its highest first-quarter expansion in recent years. Vehicle loans and medium enterprises also showed strong performance.

title: "His Approach Was Risky": Mountaineers On Nirmal Purja's Legendary Climbs
content: Ten climbers, including the legendary Nepalese mountaineer, Nirmal Purja, were reported missing after an avalanche struck Broad Peak in PoK on Thursday.

title: Video: Assam Riders Cross Flooded Roads, Landslide-Hit Stretches In Nagaland
content: Heavy rain repeatedly disrupted their journey, leaving stretches of road covered in mud and making travel difficult. Landslides and cracked sections of road further slowed their progress.

content: In Leopold Aschenbrenner's short career as a hedge fund titan, he's seen both the extreme optimism around AI and the intense fear that this is just the latest technology bubble.

content: India is working to release about two dozen nationals still serving in the Russian army amid ongoing efforts.

content: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma said the government's immediate priority is to stand beside families who have suffered losses and ensure they receive the support needed to return to normal life.

content: AI safety experts said the new disclosures paint a portrait of a group of cutting-edge labs whose ability to develop dangerous autonomous hacking agents outstrips their ability to keep them under control.

content: The nodal officers appointed at the individual locations will be held accountable for the survival of the plantations under their supervision, according to the agency.

content: Assam Floods: Railway tracks were washed away due to which rail services had been hit in a major way under Tinsukia Railway division of North East Frontier Railway.

content: A strengthening El Nino that could shatter all-time records is "adding fuel to a planet already on fire" and pushing the world into "uncharted territory," UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned Friday.

content: US President Donald Trump has instructed the military to execute a fresh assault against Iran as early as this weekend, according to a Wall Street Journal report published Friday.

title: Kartarpur Corridor To Remain Shut Over Security Concerns: Centre
content: The Centre has received representations from Sikh religious groups and organisations for "early reopening" of the Sri Kartarpur Sahib Corridor, but the extant security scenario compels the corridor to "remain suspended".

title: Trump Says US Has Not Agreed To Ukraine Building Patriot Missiles
content: President Donald Trump said on Friday that the United States has not agreed to Ukraine building Patriot missiles but that talks are ongoing, adding that the US must be "very careful about letting somebody build them."

title: US Immigration Agent Arrests Johns Hopkins Researcher At Airport
content: US immigration agents arrested a Johns Hopkins University researcher at an airport where she planned to board a domestic flight.

content: The government is likely to introduce 'Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act Amendment Bill' in the Lok Sabha next week, sources said.
